data.body: Further evidence from the A1 landing session (Gerrit 3427 patch set 2, run 44429902115): [raised] failed on both ubuntu py3.11 and py3.12. Local probe on anyio 4.16.0 calling _drive_on_fresh_thread directly, alternating raised and completed: in 32 of 400 drives the loop was still alive right after gc.collect(), and all 32 were freed after a 0.5 s sleep and a second gc.collect(). An "AnyIO worker" thread was still enumerated in only 10 of those 32, so a check that only looks for a live worker thread will not catch every case; waiting on the weakref with a bounded deadline does. This flake is currently blocking the A1 Windows-portability stack (Gerrit 3427 to 3430) from getting Verified +1.
